cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You're selling the sofa but keeping my chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody offered anything for it. Have you brought its cushion back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. If someone offered twenty pounds, would you still keep it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I like pretending you're about to sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll admit I sleep with the cushion. Could you take the price sticker off before I sit?

mechanism: A expertly removes price as a confounding explanation for keeping a chair, eliciting B attachment before admitting A own attachment to its cushion.
confusable: D83 tests remembered facts; D88 tests a practical explanation to elicit longing before A risks disclosure.
comparison: Flat alternative explicitly orders admissions; chair alternative uses a hypothetical offer to eliminate resale failure as reason.
seedUse: Unsold chair, sofa, cushion, twenty pounds and price sticker derive from D88-b; S03 adds valuation-test correction and exact sale-status instruction.
